name: Ceramics
task: specifying, sourcing or prompting fired clay: tableware, teaware, kitchen and storage ware, vases and display vessels, figures, tiles, architectural ceramics and sanitary and technical ware
description: Ceramics styles in eight branches: tableware, teaware, kitchen and storage ware, vessels, figures, tiles, architectural ceramics, and sanitary and technical ware. Each style is the rule set of one branch in one period: form, clay body, forming, glaze and decoration, palette and firing, with three to six signature pieces. A closed vocabulary names each clay body, glaze and decoration with the year and the place where it began, so that the styles also give a history of clay and glaze.

vectors.label: Ornamentation
vectors.high: painted, printed, moulded or gilt ornament on every part

vectors.label: Hand mark
vectors.high: each piece shows the hand: throwing rings, finger marks, irregular rims

vectors.label: Refinement
vectors.high: thin, white, dense or translucent body

vectors.label: Glaze depth
vectors.low: a flat, even glaze or bare clay
vectors.high: deep, variegated glaze effects: pooling, crackle, ash runs, flambé

assets.purpose: A board of glaze test tiles of the style: each tile shows a clay body under a glaze in the palette of the style, with the name and the year of origin of the body, the glaze and the decoration.

knobs.label: Ornament level
knobs.description: The share of the visible surface that carries decoration (painting, print, relief, gilding): 0 = none, 1 = every part.

knobs.label: Glaze gloss
knobs.description: The gloss of the main surface in gloss units at 60 degrees: 0 to 10 = bare clay or a dry matte glaze, 10 to 60 = satin, 60 and more = a glassy glaze.

knobs.label: Wall thickness
knobs.description: The wall of the main piece in millimetres: 1 to 3 = eggshell and bone china, 4 to 8 = tableware and thrown pots, 10 and more = tiles, cladding and sanitary ware.

knobs.label: Hand mark
knobs.description: How much each piece shows the hand: 0 = machine-exact and identical, 1 = throwing rings, finger marks and irregular rims on each piece.

knobs.label: Era blend
knobs.description: How far a piece moves from a period original: 0 = a period piece or a faithful reproduction, 1 = a contemporary piece that only quotes the period.
